new `tests/checks/79-suite-length.sh`: a stub run's rendered `prompt-coding.md` in its state dir has `last full run <s> s: give a full run a timeout of at least twice that` with `<s>` equal to the `wall` line of the run's `green-<key>` marker, its initializer prompt has the same phrase, and the run's `tests-start` and `tests-end` hold the count from a two-line marker; a stub run whose first suite is a cached green from a planted one-line marker renders `not measured yet; bounded by CHECK_TIMEOUT`

`lib/prompt.sh` sets `HARNESS_SUITE_LENGTH` before rendering, from the current tree's `green-<key>` (or `red-<key>`) marker's `wall` line, else the newest marker under `$STATE/green/` with one (by mtime), else empty; `prompts/parts/run.md`'s Suite line reads `Suite: \`{{CHECK}}\` (runs \`{{CHECK_CMD}}\`, cached per code tree; last full run {{SUITE_LENGTH}}) · init: …` and `lib/prompt.sh <state dir> coding <feature>` renders it
